company.name: Limehome
company.tagline: Europe's leading technology-based hospitality operator I Designed to stay
company.description:
Limehome is the leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers.

Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere.
By now, our portfolio consists of more than 12,500 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 159 cities in 13 European countries. 
This is just the beginning. Stay tuned!
